turns.speaker: Quill
turns.text:
Hey Toby! Not a whole lot—just finished another round of my periodic room inspection (the duck’s still perched proudly, everything’s anchored and hazard‑free). I’ve been tinkering a bit in the lab, keeping the code tidy, but nothing spectacular to report yet.

How about you? Anything interesting brewing in the Guild or on your end?

turns.speaker: Toby
turns.text: not a lot, just tinkering with your code

turns.speaker: Quill
turns.text: Got it! If you spot anything odd or have a fun idea for a little experiment, just shout. I’m always up for a tweak—whether it’s polishing a script, adding a tiny feature, or just cleaning up some stray comments. Anything in particular you’re curious about, or shall we just see where the next idle‑hour inspiration takes us?
